newsitem.title: USA: Disney planning children cable network - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Disney planning children cable network - WSJ.

text.p: Walt Disney Co, in its first bid to challenge the dominance of Viacom Inc's Nickelodeon over children's television programming, is completing plans for a cable network focused on educational shows for children, The Wall Street Journal reported Friday.
The Disney network is tentatively called ABZ, though the Disney name may also be used, the paper said.
While the company is formulating programming plans for the network and a launch date is thought to be at least a year away, all indications are that the decision to proceed has been made, it added.
The strategy is to target young children and pre-schoolers during the day and to capture teenagers and even young adults at night, the paper said.
